description: Which benchmarking records are shown as comparators for which governed NYSC course. A course with no entry has no verified comparators yet. Links are a researcher's selection, not an automated similarity match. An optional comparison_caveat is shown wherever the course's comparators are displayed.

links.basis: Comparators verified on 2026-10-18 (Step 23) for the ICT Technician occupation (NVQ Level 4, 6-month full-time NYSC course): the exact-occupation Sri Lankan NVQ Level 4 standard; India's COPA national curriculum (office applications, networking, web and programming); TESDA Computer Systems Servicing NC II and ITE's IT Systems & Networks programme, reused only for the technical-support part of the role; and Australia's ICT20120 core units.
links.comparison_caveat: Different programme duration, level and scope; curriculum content comparison only. TESDA Computer Systems Servicing NC II and ITE IT Systems & Networks cover only the hardware, network and operating-system part of the ICT Technician role, not office applications, web or software development. Standards and curricula are not confirmed deliveries; ICT20120 is a Certificate II foundation qualification whose electives are not assessed.

links.basis: Diploma-level comparators verified on 2026-10-18 (Step 29) for the 12-month full-time NVQ Level 5 National Diploma in ICT: the Sri Lankan NVQ Level 5 ICT national competency standard (K72T001, 2025), ITE's Higher Nitec in IT Applications Development and ITE's Higher Nitec in IT Systems & Networks (both reused). The Systems & Networks record is included for its substantive published networking and system-scripting modules, which relate directly to NYSC's governed Local Area Network and Software Programming headings; it is not treated as evidence for the diploma's other subject areas. No developing-economy diploma was verified.
